entries.39ad5f4a4a6957a0: This business is not included in the reportable segment. It contracts out the production of livestock products such as the specialty eggs "Gomatamago" containing sesamin and "Imubuta", and sells livestock and marine products purchased from producers. In addition, its consolidated subsidiary Chubu Ecotech Co., Ltd. and others develop, purchase and sell livestock equipment and sell compound fertilizers, its consolidated subsidiary Daikoku Co., Ltd. operates an insurance agency business, and the company leases real estate for the utilization of former factory sites and other land. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥20,633 million.
entries.3ad407b52c564280: It manufactures and sells compound feed for chickens, pigs and cattle. Sales volume increased in the fiscal year ended March 2026, driven by expanded sales of feed for laying hens and pigs. Revenue for livestock feed alone is not separately disclosed.
entries.603c356e4d555726: This is the company group's core business, manufacturing and selling livestock feed for chickens, pigs and cattle and aquaculture feed for fish, and it is the group's only reportable segment. The company manufactures and sells the products. Its consolidated subsidiary Yuhou Suisan Co., Ltd. conducts research and development of aquaculture feed and produces and sells marine products. Its equity-method affiliate Mirai Shiryo Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells livestock feed using raw materials purchased from the company. Another equity-method affiliate, Santong Chubu Feed (Shandong) Co., Ltd., manufactures and sells aquaculture feed in China. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥191,181 million, accounting for the majority of consolidated revenue.
entries.718fbdfd75ad1714: It manufactures and sells feed for fish. It is working on expanding sales of low-fishmeal and fishmeal-free feeds and on developing new products that make use of its strength in operating test fishing grounds. Revenue for aquaculture feed alone is not separately disclosed.
entries.a101916d9532f29b: A company that manufactures and sells livestock feed for chickens, pigs and cattle and aquaculture feed for fish, and also sells livestock products such as specialty eggs, and handles livestock equipment, compound fertilizers and insurance agency business.
